method_comment:
* Detects the media type of the given document. The type detection is * based on the first few bytes of a document. *

* For best results at least a few kilobytes of the document data * are needed. See also the other detect() methods for better * alternatives when you have more than just the document prefix * available for type detection. * * @param prefix first few bytes of the document * @return detected media type * @since Apache Tika 0.9
